record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Find classes of ideals that have quadratic Groebner bases.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and let $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ be a polynomial ring equipped with a monomial order $\prec$. For an ideal $I \subset S$, the initial ideal $\operatorname{in}_\prec(I)$ is the monomial ideal generated by the leading monomials (with respect to $\prec$) of all elements of $I$. A Gröbner basis of $I$ with respect to $\prec$ is a finite subset $G \subset I$ whose leading monomials generate $\operatorname{in}_\prec(I)$. A Gröbner basis $G$ is called quadratic if every element of $G$ has degree at most $2$, equivalently if $\operatorname{in}_\prec(I)$ is generated by monomials of degree at most $2$. An ideal $I$ is said to have a quadratic Gröbner basis if there exists some choice of coordinates and some monomial order with respect to which $I$ admits a quadratic Gröbner basis. It is known that ideals with a quadratic Gröbner basis are Koszul, but the converse fails in general.

Problem. Identify and describe broad classes of homogeneous ideals $I \subset S$ that possess a quadratic Gröbner basis. In particular, give structural or combinatorial criteria on $I$ (or on the algebra $S/I$) that guarantee the existence of coordinates and a monomial order under which $I$ has a Gröbner basis consisting of polynomials of degree at most $2$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is an intentionally open-ended research direction. While many specific classes of ideals are known to have quadratic Gröbner bases (e.g., certain toric ideals associated to compressed/unimodular configurations, edge ideals of bipartite graphs satisfying combinatorial conditions, ideals of 2-minors of generic matrices under suitable orders, etc.), no complete characterization is known, and the problem of identifying further classes remains an active line of research with no definitive resolution.

status_evidence.title: Quadratic Gröbner bases and Koszul algebras (survey context)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys describe ongoing efforts to find new classes of ideals with quadratic Gröbner bases, noting the implication quadratic GB ⇒ Koszul and the strictness of this implication.
status_evidence.claim: Identifying classes of ideals with quadratic Gröbner bases is an ongoing research program with many partial results but no complete classification.
